method: original art, one generated 8-panel sheet (4 cols x 2 rows: down/up/left/right x phase 1/2), border-connected white-bg flood removal (scipy label), interior whites kept, content fit to 64x64 RGBA; quakehound: component-bbox re-cut, see movement_note
eye_check: Enlarged raw sheet PASS + 64px montage PASS (after component re-cut) + enlarged left_1 PASS. Bulky dark quadruped, orange lava cracks, spiked back, tan-gold paws match locked cell; back frames faceless with tail/spikes.
movement_note: Sheet side panels cross the fixed quarter gridlines by 1-6px (nose tips), so the fixed quarter-split clipped the left noses flat. Fixed by component-bbox re-cut (scipy label on border-removed background, 8 large components sorted by row then x) — labels verified against bboxes, and one mis-sorted run (y-sort swapped directions) was caught and corrected before delivery. Faint grey ground shadow survives under down_0 (Kittember/Razorgater-class caveat, batch-1 precedent: accepted, flagged). Down phase 1 is a wide sprawl, phase 2 narrower — distinct.
style_note: Sheet is smooth cartoon; locked cell is pixelated. Shape/colour/markings match; drift flagged, not silently changed.
